notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l005: Red scabbards are the Chinese martial epithet in the source, not a skin-color description.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l009: Башаалуу means possessing a king: Yudakhin башаа = бадыша and 2015 БАШААЛУУ = падышалуу, https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=ru&lto=ru&page=main&word=БАША.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l014: Körögöch is a listed individual, as in1334:19, with a far-seeing/perceptive name; retained as a name rather than silently converted into an unnamed scout. Shuykuchu follows established spelling.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l015: Ugarkulak (Hearing-Ear) and Kanzharkol (Dagger-Hand) are listed individuals here. Kanzharkol also appears as an individual in1630–1631; the apparent recurrence after his reported death is not harmonized. Elsewhere Dagger-Hands denotes a class of trained fighters.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l017: Zhelzhetpes means Wind-Cannot-Catch but is a named member of the eight here. All eight listed members are retained; Kongurbay stands apart at19–21.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l020: Kalcha is the fierce epithet of Kongurbay, not a separate ninth figure. Акылга дыйкан is rich/productive in wisdom, not his literal occupation.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l026: The source asks to be loaded onto a thoroughbred, followed by permission for God to reclaim his entrusted life29. Object me is contextual; no additional corpse or burial destination is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l029: Аманат here is life entrusted by God, not a material deposit. This is a character’s death prayer following a wish to slay the eight opponents.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l030: Printed negative кылба is retained, although it seems in tension with his desire to kill the eight and take blood from Beijing31–32. Not silently emended to кыл or made affirmative.
notes.manas-2010:p1696:b001:l036: Brothers is comradeship language, not a claim that Almambet and Syrgak are Manas’s biological siblings.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l002: Two eyes become four is a formula of intense watching/anxious expectancy; the image is retained, not anatomical multiplication asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l008: Doorway-height distance retained as the source’s close-range image. The shimmering sight7 and button-sized heads6 are not harmonized into measured ballistics.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l013: The drum stroke is immediately apposed to Akkelte14 and followed by the gunshot16. Rendered as the gun’s thunderous drum image; no additional artillery piece invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l019: The eight includes Joykara and Kojojash18, not eight additional men. The single shot tearing off all heads21 is retained as epic hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l025: Manzhuu is the Manchu collective here, paired with Chinese and Solon26, not the personal name Manzhuu found elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l033: Урдуу radiant/charming, established Yudakhin урдуу = нурдуу; not Urdu language or an ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p1697:b001:l036: Raw and image print толгонун; contextual minimal verbal reading turned/rolled from толгон-/толгонуп, following waking35 and right side36. Raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l003: The naked child beneath Kanykei’s arm is associated syntactically with foretelling six months ahead1697:42–1698:1. Kept as the supernatural image; not silently equated with infant Semetey or omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l007: Breaking ribs is grief imagery here, not a new physical injury reported by the narrator.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l012: The blunted-horn blue bull and its underwater bellow are dream images; Kanykei herself connects this to Alma14.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l015: White falcon is the dream symbol here, followed by Chubak17–18; it is not asserted that the named hunting bird literally lost its wings.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l020: Qibla is the prayer direction, retained in the fallen plane-tree dream image.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l022: Eighteen thousand worlds is the source’s cosmological formula, not a factual census.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l025: Broken throne legs signify the fallen mount in Kanykei’s own next question26–27. No change to the literal dream image.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l034: Көөнү келсе rendered if this foreboding is true, as in the established dream interpretation formula; conditional uncertainty retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l035: The printed forty-two is retained as forty-two encirclements; no missing army unit silently supplied. Forty-two san appears explicitly at1715:18.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l036: Бейлебей derives from бейле attend to/watch, not a place-name; Kanykei warns about Manas left without care. Same root in1715:30.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l037: Hapless wife supplies Kanykei as the contextual speaker of бейбагы; the source uses third-person self-reference amid direct address.
notes.manas-2010:p1698:b001:l038: Chaliyar is retained as the established sacred name; Beijing’s inaccessibility to Chaliyar and prophets is the epic’s religious claim, not historical verification.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l002: Piebald-headed horses on the hills retained as the parallel landscape verse; not collapsed into the following young-son warning.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l006: The accusation against brothers and six scoundrels8 is Kanykei’s speech. Pronoun shifts from his to you follow the source’s alternating address.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l014: Бадыраң темир common iron follows Yudakhin; the contrast is with high-quality steel, not a cucumber-shaped weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l020: Six horses explicitly retained although the ensuing narrative concentrates on two. No deletion or invented explanation for the others.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l026: Head in gold coins/feet on gold27 kept as Bakai’s lavish accoutrement image. The preceding shield25 permits an alternative shield-top/base attachment; exact physical referent remains provisional, not a verified reconstruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l034: Асый чыкма marks newly attained horse maturity (asiy counted from about five), not the rider’s age. Subsequent occurrences use the same broad wording without an exact modern age conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1699:b001:l037: Боконо short/floating ribs, not shoulder blades: Yudakhin and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/бокон/. The strong-body image accompanies maturity38.
notes.manas-2010:p1700:b001:l003: Буттап by the pood, the source’s weight unit; no invented kilogram equivalent.
notes.manas-2010:p1700:b001:l007: The prohibition on riding without ablution belongs to the horse’s sacred prestige; it is not a present-day religious instruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1700:b001:l014: Becoming a stranger to Manas is the printed reaction to asking for the prized horse. Not softened to ordinary bargaining.
notes.manas-2010:p1700:b001:l030: Окоро are rounded joining knots, supported by Yudakhin око/окоро; not left as an unexplained English pseudo-word.
notes.manas-2010:p1700:b001:l033: Control of one horse’s mouth is Bakai’s rein struggle in context; the Kyrgyz clause leaves the immediate subject compressed. No second rider invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1701:b001:l014: Printed сел flood retained, despite parallel surrounding lines ending эл people. No silent emendation to make the series uniform.
notes.manas-2010:p1701:b001:l019: The dug trench is retained independently of the surrounding crowd/ridge visual comparisons.
notes.manas-2010:p1701:b001:l035: Bakai fears Manas has been shot and slaughtered; this is not narrator confirmation, as the following reunion makes clear.
notes.manas-2010:p1702:b001:l005: The breeding-stallion humiliation is the explicit fear about captive Manas and Beijing women, not softened or presented as an accomplished event.
notes.manas-2010:p1702:b001:l013: Чай алган mountain from which tea is obtained rendered tea-growing mountain; exact locality and cultivation versus gathering are not independently established.
notes.manas-2010:p1702:b001:l031: Arbuudan, Buurul and Taibuurul alternate in the source for the led mount; spellings are retained rather than creating three separately supplied horses.
notes.manas-2010:p1702:b001:l040: No father/no mother40–41 is the horse’s supernatural-origin assertion, retained despite the earlier rearing narrative.
notes.manas-2010:p1703:b001:l002: Saikal is identified by father Karacha here. Her two repeated gift statements1–3 are both retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1703:b001:l004: Кожосан rendered revered master as an honorific of Bakai, not a separate man leading the horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1703:b001:l020: Аккаңкы white saddle follows the local edition glossary1833:29–31 and established1555/1580 usage; not a second horse or an additional imported weapon name.
notes.manas-2010:p1703:b001:l028: Кара кылып is reliance/support here; the source refers to Khan Chubak29. Not literal blackening of the companion.
notes.manas-2010:p1703:b001:l034: Ulak’s son is Syrgak, named37; the delayed naming and repeated martyr statements are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l011: Суп чепкен fine white cloth coat; Yudakhin supplies expensive white silk OR white camel-wool cloth, https://el-sozduk.kg/суп/. Fiber is deliberately not over-specified as cotton.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l019: Reviving the dead soul is restoration of courage/hope in context, not resurrection of a physically dead Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l023: Friendship at six years is printed and retained even if chronology elsewhere differs. No biographical harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l025: Келеме шарып кармашкан follows the established oath upon the Holy Quran interpretation; wheat-flour chewing24 retained as part of the oath scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l037: Машаган skillfully fashioned; not the noun gun trigger. Forged/tempered steel context does not specify a modern heat-treatment recipe.
notes.manas-2010:p1704:b001:l041: Тамандаш- bracing with the feet, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/тамандаш/ and /таманда/. Revised from generic holding ground to preserve the physical image in the saddle-strength passage.
notes.manas-2010:p1705:b001:l005: The saddle originally fits Akkula and now perfectly fits young Buurul7–13; all three matching-harness comparisons retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1705:b001:l014: Көйкашка renowned/illustrious, established Yudakhin көйкашка; not shameless.
notes.manas-2010:p1705:b001:l015: Printed амаз read as намаз prayers, the same initial-н loss found nearby. Raw retained; subsequent prayer scene1714–1716 supports the reading.
notes.manas-2010:p1705:b001:l023: Karykan and Esenkan are not silently unified; this oath says Karykan, while1713:29 says Esenkan.
notes.manas-2010:p1705:b001:l032: Chewing/grinding door-wide teeth is retained as anger hyperbole, not consumption of some unstated food.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l002: The six heavenly blades and Zulpuqor are kept as the poem names/counts them, without harmonizing the six-name list elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l009: The edge is not notched by striking stone: invulnerable-sword hyperbole. The even stronger cutting before swinging15 is also retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l020: Келеме бото netted outer garment follows established glossary-supported usage; not camel meat or a Quran phrase here.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l022: Келеп темир = thin metal wire, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/келеп/. Мадат- causative insert, https://el-sozduk.kg/мада/115–128,552–565; revised from erroneous blunting to wire inserted into the armor.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l027: Seven years of manufacture explicitly retained, not converted to a short tailoring interval.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l028: Oрумбур is Orenburg; the anachronistic geographical name is retained as in the oral text.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l034: Steel filings, sifted fine sand, glue and layering34–37 are the literal armor-description details. No ballistic effectiveness independently asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l038: Кере fully/in full measure, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кере/306–312; мадат inserted. Rendered with iron inserted throughout, not an unsupported named metal or broad iron plate.
notes.manas-2010:p1706:b001:l040: Ашаганда машаган interpreted consummate skilled working in the manufacture sequence; precise technique remains unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p1707:b001:l004: Kanykei’s tiring front teeth from biting the armor/thread and strained eyes6 are retained as work imagery, not editorial biography.
notes.manas-2010:p1707:b001:l012: Akkise is the named heavenly belt, not a second armor coat; the next ridged/lacquered spans14–16 describe the spear.
notes.manas-2010:p1707:b001:l014: Тутам grasp-length rendered handspan broadly; exact dimensions unverified, and adjacent alternation ridged/lacquered retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1707:b001:l023: Arkesken is the named blade, followed by axes. Its recurrence with Zulpuqor is retained without reducing the armament list.
notes.manas-2010:p1707:b001:l038: Printed ден read as деп quotative;39 prints Каарданын, contextual Каарданып raging. Minimal grammatical repairs only, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1708:b001:l006: The quoted boast opens with an incomplete whoever challenges clause; no invented missing action or verse supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1708:b001:l009: Кызыккан кымбат жоо rendered coveted, worthy enemy; exact boast idiom remains provisional. Not changed into expensive booty.
notes.manas-2010:p1708:b001:l018: Printed Чокон retained and read single, supported by2015 ЧОКОН1 one/sole, https://el-sozduk.kg/чокон/. Not silently corrected to чоко or assigned an unsupported short-barrel weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1708:b001:l027: The text names Gabriel as soul-taker, not Azrael. This religious-role discrepancy is retained. Likewise five hands28 remains literal, not corrected to fingers or one hand.
notes.manas-2010:p1708:b001:l037: The narrator reports near-destruction of the small Muslim force under Manas’s rage, not only enemy losses. The negative moral consequence is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1709:b001:l012: Concern for wives and children is derided by the narrator/commander within this martial classification, not by the translator; the group is not omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1709:b001:l024: Khojas are religious dignitaries/holy men, distinguished here by turbans, call-to-prayer voices and motley coats, not ordinary household masters.
notes.manas-2010:p1709:b001:l036: Earth turning/blazing37 and trembling41 retain the epic impact image. Exact subject attachment across39–42 remains compressed; no tactical maneuver invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1710:b001:l018: The martyrs had previously killed the strongest Chinese before dying themselves; the wording does not require a new ghost-army attack.
notes.manas-2010:p1710:b001:l027: Printed Өлүп Манас келди literally permits Manas came dead; rendered a panic cry that he has come back dead. Alternative segmentation We are dead—Manas has come is possible; no silent change to өлбөй alive.
notes.manas-2010:p1710:b001:l037: Какайлатып causative making stand rigid/upright; terror is contextual. Not read as the personal name Kakay.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l013: All six-thousand/six-hundred/seven-thousand/seven-hundred per-person horse counts retained without correcting the epic scale.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l018: Топон аяк pauper, Yudakhin and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/топон/. Not chaff-feet, a gait problem, or a name.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l020: Бил elephants, established Yudakhin бил I; next line loads gold on them. Not understand/know or an invented animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l022: Жан аябас men who risk their own lives; revised away from an unsupported assertion that they spare no one else.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l027: Some twelve thousand girls, thousand dark-eyed captives23 and skilled women24 are all explicit spoils figures. Coercive capture is not softened into voluntary migration.
notes.manas-2010:p1711:b001:l028: Агача noble/high-status female term; not wood. The list distinguishes young wives from girls.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l004: The annal/register claim is the narrator’s statement within the poem, not independently verified Chinese archival evidence.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l013: Кун blood-price/compensation for slain companions; the beyond-the-world exaggeration is retained, not a currency valuation.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l023: Топон суу is the mythic world Flood in this fortress-inaccessibility formula; Yudakhin топон II and2015 ТОПОН СУУ quote the same form, https://el-sozduk.kg/топон/.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l030: Forty cubits in trench and wall40–41 retained as source units without claiming surveyed dimensions.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l032: Шор is brine/saltwater here with boiling; wordplay with misfortune шор36 is retained by differing contextual English senses.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l036: Боо III = бул this, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/боо/455–456. Read whoever challenges this place; not an unexplained rope in the threat formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1712:b001:l037: Baltai is the actual battle cry printed for Manas here, despite its usual association with Chubak. No harmonization to Manas! or Jakyp!.
notes.manas-2010:p1713:b001:l003: Corner breadth permitting forty abreast and forty-thousand workers for forty years7–8 are retained as hyperbole, not structural engineering measurements.
notes.manas-2010:p1713:b001:l011: Кызыталак is the source’s coarse daughter-directed curse, Yudakhin кызыталак = кызы талак. Rendered daughter-damned rather than silently omitted or asserted as literal divorce.
notes.manas-2010:p1713:b001:l017: The source directly condemns Manas’s command as slaughtering survivors. Revised from an unjustified almost; no softening of the consequence.
notes.manas-2010:p1713:b001:l035: Twin lambs metaphor for close companions; not a claim that Almambet and Chubak/Syrgak are literal twins.
notes.manas-2010:p1714:b001:l006: Ajybai dislodges only a teacup-sized amount, contrasted with Manas and Bakai’s major blows. Not inflated into equal success.
notes.manas-2010:p1714:b001:l014: Эстеген сайын whenever they remember/think of it retained as a terror formula; no silent change to hearing the blows.
notes.manas-2010:p1714:b001:l019: Тобуңуз your company/group distinguished from standing17 and strength21; no merging of the three warnings.
notes.manas-2010:p1714:b001:l031: Кара суу rendered spring-fed stream in the established hydrological sense; Batkaktuu retained as the locality name, without a modern coordinate assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1714:b001:l037: Twelve pairs of khans is printed; not reduced to twelve khans or confused with twelve fallen wolves1715:13.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l015: Кызыр чапкан жол literally road cut by Khizr, kept as a sacred-path image. Comparable positive campaign formula occurs in Y. Abdrakhmanov’s Kyrgyz transcription, vol1 p431, https://manas-discovery.kg/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Ы.АБДРАХМАНОВ_1-китеп_на-печать.pdf. Exact theological implication remains provisional; not presented as a verified historical route.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l018: Forty-two san retained as an epic multitude unit without an invented exact headcount; not added to the literal forty-two encirclements1698:35.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l025: The causative account holds the expedition’s leader responsible for Almambet’s martyrdom; not softened to a detached death report.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l030: Бейлебей without attending/caring, followed by жеп consumed, preserves the narrator’s condemnation of Manas for losing the champions. Not literal cannibalism.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l038: Raw жандынбаары split grammatically жандын баары all who; no changed Kyrgyz extraction.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l041: Сурап demanding/asking for Beijing followed by turning back; ruling/claiming it is another possible nuance. The construction remains provisional rather than asserting an achieved conquest.
notes.manas-2010:p1715:b001:l042: Relative clause continues into1716:1, referring to the lost Syrgak whom he cherished as a gift. It does not describe an additional present offered to China at this moment.

Yudakhin кыйык gives oblique cut/target thread/stubbornness (https://el-sozduk.kg/кыйык/), none establishes this complete clause. No invented river name, tactical maneuver, or word substitution. Entire verse preserved separately and excluded from English.
